meta.title: Loan Calculators | Multi-brand demos
meta.description: Self-contained debt, loan, home, auto, savings, and insurance calculators. Sample rates are illustrative only — not offers.

header.title: Loan, savings & coverage calculators
header.intro: Self-contained prototypes for UX and product exploration. Sample rates and defaults are illustrative only — not offers, quotes, or guarantees.

demoBanner.strong: Sample / demo only — not an offer.
demoBanner.body: These tools do not constitute loan offers, rate locks, insurance quotes, or compliance guarantees.

cards.title: Debt payoff calculator
cards.description: Compare paying minimums, waiting, your own payoff plan, and an illustrative program cost.

cards.title: Consolidation options estimator
cards.description: Slide your debt amount to compare indicative personal loan, home equity, and program ranges.

cards.title: Debt-to-income calculator
cards.description: See your DTI and where it falls in commonly used ranges.

cards.title: Personal loan calculator
cards.description: Estimate monthly payments, total interest, and total cost with optional origination fee (financed).

cards.title: Loan calculator
cards.description: Monthly installment, total interest, and the effect of extra payments.

cards.title: Student loan calculator
cards.description: Standard repayment, capitalized interest, and extra-payment payoff.

cards.title: Mortgage calculator
cards.description: Estimate principal & interest, optional PITI, total interest, and loan amount from price and down payment.

cards.title: Refinance calculator
cards.description: Monthly savings, break-even on closing costs, and lifetime cost difference.

cards.title: HELOC calculator
cards.description: Estimate borrowing power, interest-only, fixed P&I, or draw-then-repay payments, and LTV / CLTV.

cards.title: Car loan calculator
cards.description: Payment with sales tax, fees, down payment, and trade-in equity.

cards.title: Auto lease calculator
cards.description: Lease payment from residual, money factor, term, and tax.

cards.title: Monthly budget calculator
cards.description: Income vs spending with a 50/30/20 comparison.

cards.title: Savings calculator
cards.description: Compound growth of deposits, in nominal and today’s dollars.

cards.title: Retirement savings calculator
cards.description: Projected balance and an illustrative retirement income.

cards.title: Coverage need estimator
cards.description: Illustrative DIME-style coverage need plus an illustrative premium range.

cards.title: Car insurance cost estimator
cards.description: Rough premium from a transparent, editable factor table.

cards.title: Home insurance cost estimator
cards.description: Rough homeowners premium from coverage and editable factors.

footer.note: Multi-brand calculator demos hosted on Vercel (Next.js). Visual patterns are illustrative only. CTAs inside each calculator are placeholders (not live applications).

sections.title: Debt & loans
sections.description: Payoff, consolidation, DTI, and personal loans.

sections.title: Insurance
sections.description: Rough, illustrative coverage and cost estimates — not quotes.
